description: This file implements a Bluetooth LE extended advertising example using Zephyr RTOS, managing connection events, advertising start/stop, and connection callbacks.

methods.name: raise_evt
methods.description: Sets event bitmask and signals poll event to indicate a connection or disconnection event.

methods.name: connected_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon Bluetooth connection establishment, references connection object and raises connected event.

methods.name: disconnected_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon disconnection, unreferences connection object and raises disconnected event.

methods.name: recycled_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a recycled connection object is available, signals disconnection.

methods.name: start_advertising
methods.description: Starts extended advertising with specified parameters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, creating advertising set, and managing connection events in a loop.
